# Implementation Plan for powerfulwebsites.space

## Overview
This plan outlines the steps to implement a modern, high-performance, and visually appealing website using Angular v20+ with standalone components and Angular Signals for state management. The site will showcase a curated list of powerful websites, with data managed via Supabase.

## Tasks

- [x] Add LICENSE file (MIT)
- [x] Add project README
- [x] Set up Angular v20+ project (standalone, signals, SSG, Tailwind, SCSS)
- [x] Configure Tailwind CSS v4 (dark mode only, yellow primary)
- [x] Set up Supabase integration (env, service, types)
- [x] Create core layout: header (GitHub link, badge), footer (GitHub, copyright, owner, add website)
- [x] Home page: intro, latest websites, CTA
- [x] Search & filter page: search by name/tags, list from Supabase
- [x] Website detail page: info, tags, link
- [x] SSG build config
- [ ] Responsive design & accessibility improvements
- [ ] Polish, test, and document

## Next Steps
With the core functionality now complete, the remaining tasks focus on improving the user experience and preparing for production:

1. **Responsive design & accessibility improvements**: Enhance mobile experience and add accessibility features
2. **Polish, test, and document**: Final refinements, testing, and documentation updates
3. **Supabase database setup**: Configure actual database with real data for production use

## Prioritization
1. Project scaffolding & config
2. Core layout (header/footer)
3. Supabase integration
4. Home/Search/Detail pages
5. Styling & responsiveness
6. SSG & SEO
7. Final polish
